final: WITH src AS (SELECT source, SUM(amount) AS s FROM income GROUP BY source), tot AS (SELECT SUM(s) AS t FROM src), paired AS (SELECT src.s AS s, src.s * 1.0 / tot.t AS r FROM src JOIN tot ON tot.t IS NOT NULL), av AS (SELECT AVG(s) AS a FROM paired), kept AS (SELECT paired.s AS s, paired.r AS r, av.a AS a FROM paired JOIN av ON av.a IS NOT NULL WHERE paired.s > av.a) SELECT AVG(s) AS avg_kept_sum, AVG(r) AS avg_ratio, AVG(s - a) AS avg_diff FROM kept
